SD1.name: SD 1.x / SD 1.5
SD1.description: Standard Stable Diffusion 1.x models. VAE usually bundled, external VAE optional for better quality.

SD2.name: SD 2.x / SD 2.1
SD2.description: Stable Diffusion 2.x models with 768x768 native resolution. VAE usually bundled, external VAE optional.

LCM.name: LCM (SD1.5)
LCM.description: Latent Consistency Model distilled from SD1.5. Enables fast 2-8 step generation. Negative prompts have no effect.

SDXS-512.name: SDXS-512
SDXS-512.description: Ultra-fast one-step inference model with tiny U-Net. Real-time generation with single step. Based on SD1.x architecture with AutoEncoderTiny VAE.

SDXL.name: SDXL
SDXL.description: SDXL models. External VAE optional but recommended for better colors.

SSD-1B.name: SSD-1B (Segmind)
SSD-1B.description: Segmind Stable Diffusion 1B - distilled SDXL with reduced U-Net. 50% smaller and 60% faster than SDXL while maintaining quality.

Vega.name: Vega (Segmind)
Vega.description: Segmind Vega - distilled SDXL model with 1B parameters. Optimized for speed while maintaining quality similar to SDXL.

LCM-SDXL.name: LCM (SDXL)
LCM-SDXL.description: Latent Consistency Model distilled from SDXL. Enables fast 2-8 step generation at 1024x1024. Negative prompts have no effect.

SD3.name: SD3 / SD3.5
SD3.description: Stable Diffusion 3. Requires CLIP-L, CLIP-G, and T5-XXL text encoders.

Flux.name: Flux
Flux.description: Black Forest Labs Flux models. Requires VAE (ae.safetensors or ae.gguf), CLIP-L, and T5-XXL.

downloads.label: FLUX.1-dev (Q4_K GGUF, ~9 GB)
downloads.notes: GGUF quant balanced for consumer GPUs

downloads.label: FLUX.1-dev (Q8_0 GGUF, ~13 GB)
downloads.notes: Higher quality, higher VRAM

downloads.label: ae.safetensors (Flux VAE)
downloads.notes: Public mirror of the Flux VAE. Same file shared with Z-Image so a second download of the same file is a no-op.

Flux Schnell.name: Flux Schnell
Flux Schnell.description: Fast Flux variant optimized for speed. Same requirements as Flux, fewer steps needed.

Flux Kontext.name: FLUX.1-Kontext-dev
Flux Kontext.description: Flux-based image editing model. Edit images with text prompts. Requires same components as Flux plus a reference image.

downloads.label: ae.safetensors (Flux VAE - shared with Flux)
downloads.notes: Same file as Flux; a second click is a no-op.

Flux2 Dev.name: Flux.2 Dev
Flux2 Dev.description: Flux 2 development model with advanced LLM integration. Requires Flux2 VAE (flux2_ae.safetensors) and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B LLM. Supports image editing with reference images.

downloads.label: FLUX.2 VAE (flux2-vae.safetensors)
downloads.notes: Landed as FLUX.2/ae.safetensors so it doesn't collide with the Flux 1 ae.

Flux2 Klein 4B.name: Flux.2 Klein 4B
Flux2 Klein 4B.description: Fast 4B parameter Flux2 model. Requires Flux2 VAE and Qwen3 4B LLM. Optimized for speed with only 4 steps. Supports image editing.

downloads.label: FLUX.2 VAE (flux2-vae.safetensors)
downloads.notes: Shared with Flux.2 Dev; a second download of the same file is a no-op.

downloads.label: Qwen3 4B (safetensors)
downloads.notes: Cross-arch shared with Z-Image (same Qwen3 4B weights).

Flux2 Klein Base 4B.name: Flux.2 Klein Base 4B
Flux2 Klein Base 4B.description: Higher quality 4B parameter Flux2 model. Same requirements as Klein 4B but needs more steps and higher CFG for better results.

Flux2 Klein 9B.name: Flux.2 Klein 9B
Flux2 Klein 9B.description: Fast 9B parameter Flux2 model with better quality than 4B. Requires Flux2 VAE and Qwen3 8B LLM. Optimized for speed with only 4 steps.

Flux2 Klein Base 9B.name: Flux.2 Klein Base 9B
Flux2 Klein Base 9B.description: Higher quality 9B parameter Flux2 model. Same requirements as Klein 9B but needs more steps and higher CFG for better results.

Z-Image.name: Z-Image Turbo
Z-Image.description: Requires VAE (ae.gguf) and LLM (Qwen3 4B recommended). Very fast generation with high quality. Uses VRAM offloading for 12GB GPUs.

downloads.label: Z-Image Turbo (Q4_K GGUF)
downloads.notes: Smaller / lower VRAM alternative

downloads.label: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (Q4_K_M GGUF)
downloads.notes: GGUF alternative for lower-VRAM setups

Qwen.name: Qwen-Image
Qwen.description: Qwen-based image generation. Requires VAE and LLM (Qwen2.5-VL 7B).

Qwen-Image-2.1.name: Qwen-Image 2.1
Qwen-Image-2.1.description: Qwen-Image 2.1 text-to-image + image editing. Uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as the LLM (mmproj required for editing) and its own qwen_image_2.1 VAE (not interchangeable with the earlier Qwen / Wan 2.2 VAEs). Added upstream via leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp#1994.

downloads.label: Qwen-Image 2.1 (Q4_K GGUF)
downloads.notes: Balanced quality / VRAM for 12-16 GB GPUs

downloads.label: Qwen-Image 2.1 (Q8_0 GGUF)
downloads.notes: Higher quality, higher VRAM

downloads.label: mmproj-Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct-F16.gguf (needed for editing with a GGUF LLM)

LLaDA-Image.name: LLaDA-Image
LLaDA-Image.description: LLaDA-Image 6B text-to-image and instruction-guided editing. Denoiser is a Lumina2/Z-Image-style NextDiT conditioned by a LLaDA2-MoE diffusion-LLM text encoder, reusing the Flux.2 VAE. Requires a transformer, text encoder, VAE, and an embeddings_connectors file (QueryFormer + text_projection, plus SigVQ image encoder for editing). Two checkpoints ship: base (50 steps) and Turbo (4 steps) - each with its own transformer + text encoder + connectors, only VAE and tokenizer are shared. Added upstream via leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp#1968.

requiredComponents.embeddings_connectors: llada-image-connectors.safetensors (add -edit for image editing; carries SigVQ)

downloads.label: LLaDA-Image-Turbo transformer (4 steps, F16 GGUF)
downloads.notes: Distilled 4-step variant. Recommended for most users.

downloads.label: LLaDA-Image transformer (50 steps, F16 GGUF)
downloads.notes: Full 50-step base model.

downloads.label: LLaDA2-MoE text encoder for Turbo (Q8_0 GGUF)
LLaDA2-MoE text encoder for base 50-step (Q8_0 GGUF)
Turbo connectors + SigVQ (for image editing)
downloads.notes: Choose the -edit variant if you want image editing; carries the 2.6 GB SigVQ encoder.

downloads.label: llada_vae.safetensors (from inclusionAI)
downloads.notes: Same file works for both Turbo and base variants.

Qwen Image Edit.name: Qwen-Image-Edit
Qwen Image Edit.description: Qwen-based image editing model. Edit images with text prompts. Requires Qwen VAE and Qwen2.5-VL 7B LLM. Three checkpoints ship: base Qwen-Image-Edit, the 2509 revision, and the 2511 revision (which needs `model_args=qwen_image_zero_cond_t=true`).

optionalComponents.llm_vision: Qwen2.5-VL-7B mmproj (needed for image editing with a GGUF LLM)

downloads.label: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (Q4_K_M GGUF)
downloads.notes: Latest revision. Requires `--model-args qwen_image_zero_cond_t=true` at generation time; also pair with a Q8_0 llm_vision mmproj for best edit quality.

downloads.label: qwen_image_vae.safetensors
downloads.notes: Same file works for base Qwen and every Qwen-Image-Edit revision.

downloads.label: Qwen2.5-VL-7B mmproj (Q8_0, needed for editing with a GGUF LLM)

Ovis.name: Ovis-Image-7B
Ovis.description: Ovis-Image model for text-to-image generation. Requires Flux VAE (ae.safetensors) and Ovis 2.5 LLM text encoder.

Chroma-Radiance.name: Chroma1-Radiance
Chroma-Radiance.description: Chroma variant that doesn't require VAE. Only needs T5-XXL text encoder.

Wan.name: Wan T2V (Video)
Wan.description: Text-to-Video model. Requires VAE and T5-XXL (umt5 variant recommended).

downloads.label: umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors
downloads.notes: T5-XXL variant used by every Wan variant

Wan-S2V.name: Wan 2.2 S2V (Audio+Image to Video)
Wan-S2V.description: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B audio-to-video model. Requires the Wan 2.1 VAE, umt5-xxl text encoder, and a wav2vec2 audio encoder (wav2vec2_large_english_fp16). Added upstream via leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp#1925.

downloads.label: Wan2.2-S2V-14B (Q4_K_M GGUF, ~9 GB)
downloads.notes: Balanced quality / VRAM

downloads.label: Wan2.2-S2V-14B (Q8_0 GGUF, ~15 GB)
downloads.notes: Higher quality, needs more VRAM

Anima.name: Anima
Anima.description: CircleStone Labs Anima model. Requires Qwen Image VAE and Qwen3 0.6B Base LLM as text encoder.

downloads.label: Anima preview (Q4_K_M GGUF)
downloads.notes: Lower-VRAM alternative

downloads.label: Qwen3-0.6B-Base (Q4_K_M GGUF)
downloads.notes: GGUF alternative

HiDream-O1.name: HiDream O1
HiDream-O1.description: HiDream O1 image model (Comfy-Org). Self-contained checkpoint — bundles diffusion, Qwen2 text/vision conditioner, and FakeVAE. Defaults below match the Dev (distilled) variant; for the Full variant raise cfg_scale to ~5.0 and steps to ~28.

Longcat-Image.name: LongCat-Image
Longcat-Image.description: Meituan LongCat-Image (and -Edit). Uses the Flux VAE (ae.safetensors) and Qwen2.5-VL 7B as the multimodal text encoder. Supports character-level text rendering when the target text is wrapped in single, double, or Chinese quotes.

optionalComponents.llm_vision: mmproj file for image editing with GGUF text encoders

LTXAV.name: LTX 2.3 (LTXAV)
LTXAV.description: Lightricks LTX 2.3 video model. Generates frames + optional audio (saved as audio.wav alongside the frames). Requires a separate audio VAE and an embeddings_connectors file in addition to the diffusion model, video VAE, and Gemma-3 12B LLM text encoder.

generationDefaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, low quality, blurry, distorted, artifacts

Ernie-Image.name: ERNIE-Image
Ernie-Image.description: Baidu ERNIE-Image (and Turbo). Runs on ≤ 4 GB VRAM. Uses the FLUX.2 VAE and Ministral-3-3B-Instruct as the LLM text encoder. Defaults target the Turbo variant; for the full model raise cfg to ~5.0 and steps to ~20.

Lens.name: Lens
Lens.description: Comfy-Org Lens (and Turbo). Uses the FLUX.2 VAE and GPT-OSS-20B as the LLM text encoder. Defaults target the full variant; for Turbo, drop cfg_scale to 1.0 and steps to 4.

requiredComponents.llm: GPT-OSS-20B (GGUF, ~20 GB on disk — needs significant RAM)

Ideogram-4.name: Ideogram 4
Ideogram-4.description: Ideogram 4 image model. Unique among presets: requires BOTH a main diffusion model AND an `uncond_diffusion_model` (the unconditional transformer) for proper CFG. Uses the FLUX.2 VAE and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Supports tileable output via circular_x / circular_y. Convert fp8 weights to bf16 then optionally quantize to q8_0 per the docs.

PiD.name: PiD (NVIDIA Pixel Diffusion Decoder)
PiD.description: NVIDIA Pixel Diffusion Decoder. Image-edit pipeline: provide a reference image, encode it with a matching VAE, and PiD decodes/upscales directly to RGB. Requires `vae_format` to match the backbone (flux / sd3 / flux2) because the standalone VAE files don't carry that metadata. Uses Gemma 2 2B as the LLM. The official weights are under NSCLv1 non-commercial license.

requiredComponents.vae: matches the PiD checkpoint backbone (Flux / SD3 / Flux.2 ae.safetensors)

Boogu-Image.name: Boogu Image
Boogu-Image.description: Comfy-Org Boogu Image (base + Edit variants). Uses the Flux VAE (ae.safetensors) and Qwen3-VL 8B as the LLM text+vision encoder. The Edit variant also needs llm_vision (mmproj) for image-edit workflows.

optionalComponents.llm_vision: mmproj-Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct (GGUF, only for Boogu Image Edit)

downloads.label: ae.safetensors (Flux VAE, shared with Flux)
downloads.notes: Same public mirror the Flux and Z-Image entries use.

downloads.label: mmproj-Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct (F16, needed for the Edit variant)

SeFi-Image-Turbo.name: SeFi-Image (Turbo)
SeFi-Image-Turbo.description: Dual-time flow-matching T2I, Flux2 backbone + Qwen3-VL encoder, TURBO variants (1B-turbo / 2B-turbo / 5B-turbo) — 4 steps, CFG 1.0 (distilled). Now in leejet/master (PR #1707 merged via 03e9a22).

SeFi-Image-Base.name: SeFi-Image (Base)
SeFi-Image-Base.description: Dual-time flow-matching T2I, Flux2 backbone + Qwen3-VL encoder, BASE variants (1B-Base / 2B-Base / 5B-Base) — 50 steps, CFG 4.0. Now in leejet/master (PR #1707 merged via 03e9a22).

SeFi-Image-RL.name: SeFi-Image (RL)
SeFi-Image-RL.description: Dual-time flow-matching T2I, Flux2 backbone + Qwen3-VL encoder, RL-finetuned variant (5B-RL) — 50 steps, CFG 4.0. Now in leejet/master (PR #1707 merged via 03e9a22).

Krea2-Raw.name: Krea2 (Raw)
Krea2-Raw.description: Krea2 diffusion transformer (Raw variant) — 50 steps, CFG 4.0. Uses Wan 2.1 VAE and Qwen3-VL 4B encoder. Added in leejet/master via PR #1705.

downloads.label: wan_2.1_vae.safetensors
downloads.notes: Shared with Wan / Wan-S2V; a second click is a no-op.

Krea2-Turbo.name: Krea2 (Turbo)
Krea2-Turbo.description: Krea2 diffusion transformer (Turbo variant) — 4 steps, CFG 1.0. Uses Wan 2.1 VAE and Qwen3-VL 4B encoder. Added in leejet/master via PR #1705.

Krea2OstrisEdit.name: Krea2 (Ostris Edit)
Krea2OstrisEdit.description: Krea2 Flux2-family edit variant by Ostris. Uses flux2_ae VAE and Mistral-Small-Instruct or Qwen3-VL as the text encoder.

Lingbot.name: Lingbot (Video)
Lingbot.description: Lingbot text-to-video model. Uses a video VAE + T5-XXL text encoder.

AnimateDiff-v3.name: AnimateDiff v3 (SD1.5)
AnimateDiff-v3.description: AnimateDiff v3 motion module attached to an SD1.5 base. Produces short animated clips.

AnimateDiff-v2.name: AnimateDiff v2 (SD1.5)
AnimateDiff-v2.description: AnimateDiff v2 motion module attached to an SD1.5 base.

PiD-1.5.name: PiD (SD1.5)
PiD-1.5.description: PiD motion module for SD 1.5 (AnimateDiff-family). Requires an SD1.5 base plus the PiD motion module.

HunyuanVideo-1.5.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
HunyuanVideo-1.5.description: HunyuanVideo 1.5 text-to-video model. Requires LLaMA-based text encoder plus CLIP-L.

MiniT2I.name: MiniT2I
MiniT2I.description: MiniT2I diffusion transformer with flan-t5-large as the text encoder. Trained at 512x512; small and fast, useful for smoke tests and low-VRAM builds. Added upstream via leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp#1683.

downloads.label: MiniT2I b-16 diffusion (safetensors)
downloads.notes: Lands as diffusion_models/MiniT2I/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors so it doesn't collide with any other 'diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors' shipped by future architectures.

downloads.label: flan-t5-large (model.safetensors)
downloads.notes: Lands as t5xxl/flan-t5-large/model.safetensors so a T5-XXL called model.safetensors from another arch stays separate.

SenseNova-U1.5.name: SenseNova U1.5
SenseNova-U1.5.description: SenseNova U1.5 8B MoT: diffusion directly in RGB pixel space. Ships as a complete Hugging Face repo directory (model.safetensors.index.json + shards + tokenizer); no separate text encoder or VAE required. Trained at 2048x2048; width and height must be multiples of 32. Added upstream via leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp#1935.

downloads.label: SenseNova U1.5 8B MoT (full HF repo, ~16 GB)
downloads.notes: Whole-repo download - shards + tokenizer + index. sd.cpp loads the directory as --model.

Mage-Flow.name: Mage-Flow
Mage-Flow.description: Mage-Flow flow-matching model (leejet PR #1808). Flux-family: requires VAE (ae.safetensors), CLIP-L, and T5-XXL.

Minimax-H3.name: Minimax-H3
Minimax-H3.description: Minimax-H3 image model (leejet PR #1854). Ships with a trained latent2rgb projection on the VAE (PR #1856) for higher-quality live previews.

LTX-2.5.name: LTX 2.5
LTX-2.5.description: Lightricks LTX 2.5 video model (leejet PR #1893). Generates frames + optional audio. Requires the CONV variant of the video VAE (the default file is a diffusion decoder that is not supported). Uses Gemma4-12B-with-proj text encoder (larger than LTX 2.3's Gemma-3). No embeddings_connectors file is needed - the projection is embedded in the text encoder file.

generationDefaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, low quality, blurry, distorted, artifacts
